description: MELDATA, hosted by the International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas, publishes a land-cover transition map for the Kef-Siliana region of north-west Tunisia. The 10 m raster classifies changes between 2017 and 2022 among water, forest, flooded vegetation, crop, built area, bare land and rangeland. A transition-code table and three data-dictionary CSV files accompany the TIFF image. The named version 10.0 page lists five public files, gives CC BY-SA 4.0 as the licence and shows no price. For simulation, the raster can provide a dated land-cover input to agricultural adaptation or land-related hazard exposure studies. It does not identify individual infrastructure assets or show conditions after 2022. Classification accuracy and the raster values were not checked because no data file was downloaded. It is related to the catalogue AGRIDATA Tunisia portal as a separate, regional research deposit, not a replacement for national agricultural statistics. The article also names two distinct MELDATA tables derived from the same landscape work.
